title: Boneyard configuration
description: Configuration for Boneyard build capture and generated runtime defaults.

$schema.description: Path or URL to the JSON Schema used to validate this file.

breakpoints.description: Viewport widths in pixels to capture. By default, Boneyard auto-detects Tailwind breakpoints and otherwise uses 375, 768, and 1280.

out.description: Directory for generated .bones.json files and the registry. Defaults to ./src/bones when a src directory exists, otherwise ./bones.

wait.description: Milliseconds to wait after a page loads before capture. Defaults to 800.

routes.description: Routes the CLI or Vite plugin should visit. Entries may be paths or same-origin absolute URLs.

skeletons.description: Guided crawl settings keyed by skeleton name. When present, the CLI visits the configured skeleton routes instead of discovering routes.

url.description: Capture origin for the Vite plugin. Defaults to the Vite development server origin.

resolveEnvVars.description: Resolve env[NAME] placeholders in authentication cookie values and headers. Defaults to false.

color.description: Bone fill color in light mode. Accepts any CSS color. Defaults to #f0f0f0.

darkColor.description: Bone fill color in dark mode. Accepts any CSS color. Defaults to #222222.

animate.description: Animation style. Defaults to pulse. Boolean true selects pulse and false selects solid.

shimmerColor.description: Shimmer highlight color in light mode. Accepts any CSS color. Defaults to #f7f7f7.

darkShimmerColor.description: Shimmer highlight color in dark mode. Accepts any CSS color. Defaults to #2c2c2c.

speed.description: CSS animation duration for the active animation style. Defaults to 2s for shimmer and 1.8s for pulse.

shimmerAngle.description: Shimmer gradient angle in degrees. Defaults to 110.

stagger.description: Delay between bone animations in milliseconds. Defaults to false; true uses 80 ms.

transition.description: Fade-out duration in milliseconds when loading ends. Defaults to false; true uses 300 ms.

boneClass.description: CSS class applied to each generated bone element.

select.description: Width used to choose a responsive breakpoint. Defaults to container; viewport uses window.innerWidth.

auth.description: Authentication applied to the browser session used for capture.

cookies.description: Cookies added to the browser context before capture.

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers sent during capture. Host, content-length, transfer-encoding, connection, and upgrade are blocked by Boneyard.

cookie.description: A browser cookie. Boneyard forwards only these supported fields.

value.description: Cookie value. Supports env[NAME] placeholders when resolveEnvVars is true.

route.description: Route on which the named skeleton is rendered.

wait.description: Milliseconds to wait on this route before capture, overriding the top-level wait value.
